meta.title: About
meta.description: The Catholic Calendar unites Catholic organizers across dioceses to collaborate, share resources, and help the faithful discover events in their city.

hero.title: One Church. One Mission. One Calendar.
hero.subtitle: The Catholic Calendar is a unified platform that brings Catholic organizers together across dioceses—parishes, ministries, movements, and local leaders—to collaborate, share resources, and advance the Church through events.

collaboration.title: Organizer collaboration
collaboration.description: Parishes, ministries, and Catholic movements can discover one another, share resources, and coordinate so that events reach the right people at the right time.

messaging.title: Verified messaging
messaging.description: Verified organizers connect through threads and direct messages to exchange talents, tools, and ideas—making it easier to plan and execute events that serve their communities.

calendar.title: City event calendar
calendar.description: Catholics everywhere can discover what is happening in their city through a clean calendar, list, and map view—so no Mass, retreat, or social is missed.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.statement: Our mission is simple: build community, strengthen the Church, and support one another in making the Catholic faith visible and active in every city.

cta.title: Ready to share your event?
cta.body: Create a free organizer account and start submitting events to your local Catholic Calendar today.

accounts.title: Account Types
accounts.subtitle: Anyone with an account can submit events to The Catholic Calendar. Verified organizers unlock the full toolkit: instant publishing, a public profile, direct messaging, recurring events, multi-diocese broadcasts, and a built-in follower network.
accounts.howVerifiedBody: Create an organizer account on the site and apply for verification — our team reviews each request by hand and, once approved, your events post instantly with the verified badge.

submit.sameDayIntro: Take a look at the other events taking place on the day you've selected. Depending on what you're submitting, see if there's a similar event that day — if it makes sense to collaborate, feel free to reach out to the organizer and bring everyone together!
submit.posterHint: Attach a flyer or photo. It'll be shown on the event page and on the Highlights carousel.
submit.posterFormat: JPG, PNG or WebP — under 8MB. Portrait orientation looks best.
submit.featTitle: This is a big / important event
submit.featBody: Flags this event for the moderators so it can be highlighted on the calendar (e.g. a major fundraiser, conference, or city-wide gathering — not a weekly Bible study).
submit.contactUserHint: Confirm the best contact for this event (pre-filled from your organizer profile — edit if a different person is running this event).
submit.contactGuestHint: We need your name and email so we can confirm the submission and follow up with any questions.
submit.terms: I agree that this submission is a genuine Catholic opportunity — not personal promotion — and that the content is respectful, appropriate, and free of profane or inappropriate material.

submit.recurBody: Repeat this event automatically — for example a Bible study every Friday. Each occurrence is added to the calendar with the same details.
